description: Zone Wifi is a dataset listed in Aix-en-provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Aix-en-provence. Coverage: Aix-en-Provence. The portal files it under E-Spots, Mobilités/Transports. The portal shows 12 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-02-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-aix-en-provence-portal.
